questions.question: It was not until I had finished my degree that I realized the importance of developing a strong professional network.
options: I hadn't finished my degree when it became clear to me.
It wasn't until after finishing my degree that I understood.
It was only once I'd completed my studies that I appreciated.
It wasn't until after completing my education that it dawned on me.
questions.answer: It wasn't until after completing my education that it dawned on me.

questions.question: By the time she had arrived, we had already eaten dinner and were watching a movie.
options: We'd finished eating by the time she got here.
She came just as we were finishing our meal.
It was only after she'd left that we started to eat.
She hadn't arrived yet when we'd eaten.
questions.answer: We'd finished eating by the time she got here.

questions.question: Unless you're willing to compromise, it's unlikely that you'll be able to find a mutually beneficial solution.
options: You won't be able to find a solution unless you're prepared to give in.
If you don't want to compromise, finding a solution will be difficult.
It's only if you're open to negotiation that you'll succeed.
A mutually beneficial solution is unlikely unless you're willing to make concessions.
questions.answer: You won't be able to find a solution unless you're prepared to give in.

questions.question: It's essential that the company's employees are aware of their responsibilities and obligations.
options: The company's staff should know about their duties.
Employees must be informed about their roles.
That the workers understand their tasks is crucial.
That the personnel comprehend their job descriptions is vital.
questions.answer: It's essential that the company's employees are aware of their responsibilities and obligations.

questions.question: I wasn't surprised when I heard that he had resigned; after all, he'd been threatening to leave for months.
options: Given his threats to quit, it was no shock when he left.
It's not surprising that he resigned considering his past behavior.
He'd made it clear he wanted out, so his resignation wasn't unexpected.
His decision to resign was predictable given his previous statements.
questions.answer: Given his threats to quit, it was no shock when he left.
